```{r}
gene_6 <- readxl::read_excel("gene_count_6.xls")
```

```{r}
#install.packages("BiocManager")  # If not already installed
#BiocManager::install("DESeq2")

library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
counts <- gene_6 %>% select(gene_id, OS0658, OS21014, OD21014, AD22, RNA35, RNA62)

counts <- counts %>% column_to_rownames(var = "gene_id")

counts <- as.matrix(counts)

mode(counts) <- "numeric"

sample_info <- data.frame(
    row.names = colnames(counts),   # Sample names
    condition = c("control", "control", "control", "glaucoma", "glaucoma", "glaucoma")  # Group labels
)

sample_info$condition <- factor(sample_info$condition, levels = c("control", "glaucoma"))

```


```{r}

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts,
                              colData = sample_info,
                              design = ~ condition)

# Filter out low-expression genes
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 10, ]

# Run DESeq2 normalization and differential expression analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results (glaucoma vs. control)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "glaucoma", "control"))

# View summary
summary(res)

```
```{r}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%   
  drop_na()  

res_df$log2FoldChange <- as.numeric(res_df$log2FoldChange)
res_df$padj <- as.numeric(res_df$padj)

ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = padj < 0.05)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +  # Red for significant genes
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value")


```
```{r}
# Extract normalized counts
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
top_genes <- rownames(res)[1:25]

pheatmap(assay(vsd)[top_genes, ], cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE)


```
```{r}
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA of RNA-seq Data")

```
